Heat treatment: All surfaces of the cast slabs were ground to remove imperfections and provide good rolling surfaces before annealing 16 hours at 1200C in argon atmosphere. The slabs were hot rolled at 1090C to 1/16 inch thickness. Oxide scale was subsequently removed by sand blasting before a final annealing treatment. The 1 inch wide hot rolled strips were subsequently cold rolled from 0.1 inch to a final thickness of 0.0625inch.
